description: Parallel MOA* finds the exact Pareto set of paths with one thread per objective. Thread `i` runs a lexicographic multi-objective A* with objective `i` first and the others in cyclic order. A thread finds its solutions in increasing order of its lead objective. So each solution tells the other threads that every Pareto-optimal cost below it in that objective is already known. The threads share these solutions as *multi-level upper bounds*: a solution cost drops one objective each time another thread passes it, and finally becomes a scalar bound that every thread prunes against. The search stops when the first thread ends, and the non-dominated union of all solutions is the Pareto set; it needs a consistent heuristic.

papers.authors: Saman Ahmadi, Nathan R. Sturtevant, Andrea Raith, Daniel Harabor, Mahdi Jalili
papers.title: Parallelizing Multi-objective A* Search
